channel.title: theBrowser Updates
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.title: Version 0.1.3
item.description:
theBrowser 0.1.3

  • implement /open and /clean commands with loading transition
  • feat: implement Option+Click web capture system
  • implement /do command with action notes and backend integration
  • fix: update OAuth URL scheme from ora:// to thebrowser://
  • improve notes experience with performance and micro-interactions
  • Add note menu with export and delete options, increase block height
  • implement talk to video support
  • Add toggle lists for AI responses with animations
  • minor edits to the notes ai
  • Add Talk to AI button with tab mentions and full page context
  • Add AI writing assistant to notes editor
  • Add Notion-style slash menu and WYSIWYG notes editor
  • improve split view constraints and sidebar behavior
  • implemented split screen tabs
  • Fix Notes button color to match sidebar UI
  • fix unreliable bookmark section drop detection
  • fix swiftlint identifier name violations
  • animate picker to preset color on selection
  • added custom theme color picker.
  • Add CLAUDE.md with project structure and vision
